card.learned_from: Harry Beck 的伦敦地铁图（1933）、《星际穿越》的黑洞（2014，DNEG 与 Kip Thorne）、《宇宙》（1980）
card.line: 深空黑底，每种东西一个颜色全片不变：光是金、物质是珊瑚红、观测者是蓝；主镜头是着色器做的黑洞和地球
card.fit: 天文、物理、前沿科学新闻和长讲解
card.sounds_like: 光出发时一声长的气流，黑洞是一层很低的嗡，光落到地球上蓝圈亮起时钟琴响一下

semantics.light: gold: every ray, every photon, in every shot
semantics.matter: coral: what light falls on or comes from (the black hole's disk)
semantics.blue: the observers: the Earth's air, its lit cities, an instrument that detects
semantics.white: titles and plain emphasis (never gold, so gold keeps meaning light)

shaders.black_hole: ray-marched null geodesics x'' = -1.5 h² x / r⁵ (Schwarzschild, rs = 1), up to 96 steps, disk r 3–10.5, Doppler-brightened side; 640² canvas, camera 24 rs away, inclination 0.11 ± 0.05 rad
shaders.earth: 3D value-noise land, ice and cloud, lit from the upper left; night-side cities and the limb's air in the observers' blue; half-resolution canvas

motion.camera: one continuous move: drift in, hold on the hole, follow a bent ray to the Earth, pull away; eased with smootherstep between keys, smeared with half a frame of shutter when fast
motion.type: glyphs rise 10 px and fade in, staggered over 60% of the window

texture.stars: three depths (0.35, 0.6, 1.0), 2720 stars, a faint galaxy band

study.by: Harry Beck; one colour per line, kept everywhere
Double Negative (DNGR renderer) with Kip Thorne; James, von Tunzelmann, Franklin & Thorne, Classical and Quantum Gravity 32, 065001 (2015)
Carl Sagan, Ann Druyan, Steven Soter; PBS
